patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layout in hero and some feature sections, balancing a large visual element with concise text and calls to action.
Prominent, large, sans-serif headings (Geist) are paired with a monospaced font (Geist Mono) for data points and labels, creating a tech-forward, precise feel.
High contrast black/dark grey on white/light grey, with minimal use of accent colors, reinforcing a professional and serious tone.
A persistent, sticky header navigation remains visible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Alternating background colors (white and light grey) are used to clearly delineate major content sections, providing visual rhythm and separation.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, overlaying content as it scrolls beneath, providing constant access to key site links.

A large, full-height hero section uses a split layout, with a dominant image or visual on one side and the primary value proposition and call to action on the other, creating an immediate visual impact.

The site employs a strong typographic hierarchy, using very large, bold sans-serif type for primary headings and a smaller, monospaced font for supporting data and labels, creating a clear visual structure and emphasizing precision.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, often monospaced, supporting text and labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (buttons, cards, and images have minimal to no visible border-radius).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, especially in the hero).

standout: The site's distinctive use of a clean, high-contrast, almost brutalist-minimalist aesthetic combined with precise, data-driven typography (especially the monospaced font for numbers) creates a strong sense of authority and tech-savviness, avoiding typical 'finance' visual clichés. The design feels less like a traditional financial institution and more like a modern tech platform.
